The LD resource a Source carries

Source: R/ld-stores.R
og_ld_resource.Rd

og_ld_resource() returns the LD resource a Source carries (ADR 0006; see vignette("ld"), "The Source's LD resource"): the one every verb that needs LD uses. Packages built on opengwasr, such as TwoSampleMR, read it to honour the Source's LD resource.

Usage

og_ld_resource(src)

Arguments

src

A Source, from og_api() or og_local().

Value

For an API Source, its ld_store (an LD Store's name or an ancestry code), as given to og_api(ld_store = ). For a Local Source, its PLINK Reference, from og_local(bfile = , plink = ): an og_plink_reference, a list of path (absolute, with forward slashes on every platform), plink_bin (the binary's absolute path) and plink_version (as PLINK reports it, such as "1.90b6.21" or "2.0.0-b.1.4"). NULL when the Source carries none: the API Source then matches each Analysis's Assigned Ancestry, and a Local Source refuses anything that needs LD. Anything that isn't a Source is refused as every query function refuses it (class opengwasr_source_required for NULL, else opengwasr_argument).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
og_ld_resource(og_api())                    # NULL
og_ld_resource(og_api(ld_store = "EUR"))    # "EUR"
} # }
